editorial.blurb: Greek Islands brings the warmth and authenticity of the Mediterranean right to Lombard, with expertly prepared seafood and grilled specialties that transport you straight to a seaside taverna.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on special occasions or family celebrations like Easter — service shines and the kitchen delivers quickly even when busy; arrive ready for a wait but expect to be seated faster than quoted.

topDishes.note: Perfectly seasoned, juicy, grilled exactly as done overseas
Full of flavor, tender, instantly transports you to a seaside taverna
Lightly breaded, perfectly fried, incredibly tender—not rubbery
